pose: Diagonal hero shot, head tilted downward to show the dual-point tip
visual_description: A large, two-handed industrial pick-axe. The head is forged from dark, matte carbon steel with a thick central eye. One side features a sharp, elongated point for piercing hard ground; the other side is a flat, wide 'mattock' blade for prying and scraping. The handle is a sturdy, high-gloss fiberglass in a safety-yellow color with black rubberized overmolding at the grip points.

constraints.scale_reference: Should appear significantly larger and heavier than the rock pick.
constraints.background: Isolated on a neutral 50% grey studio floor with high-contrast contact shadows.
